parts.name: Root
parts.description: The container with the state. It holds the date value, the open state of the popover, and the validation. The input and the calendar share them.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the root element. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: value
props.description: The date value (YYYY-MM-DD). You can bind it. The empty state is null.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The date value at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it when the date value changes. The value is null while the text of the user is incomplete, not valid, out of the range, or unavailable.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input segments, the trigger, and the calendar.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the input focusable, but stops the changes. In the read-only mode, the calendar trigger is not in the DOM.

props.name: minValue
props.description: The first date that the user can select (YYYY-MM-DD). If the user types a date before it, the input becomes invalid. The component does not correct the date.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: The last date that the user can select (YYYY-MM-DD). If the user types a date after it, the input becomes invalid. The component does not correct the date.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Makes specified days unavailable, in the input and in the calendar.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state of the popover. You can bind it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The open state of the popover at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the popover opens or closes. The details give the cause and a `cancel()` function that stops the change.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Closes the popover when the user selects a date in the calendar.

props.name: children
props.description: The DatePicker parts that you assemble in the root.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the date picker, for when the user sees no name.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the date picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while any part of the date picker contains focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the text in the segments does not make a valid value.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the calendar popover is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the date picker is readonly.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: The date input with segments. It goes through the segments of the locale and gives each one to the children snippet.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the input element, thus a `label[for]` element can point at it. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the hidden input for the form submission. That input only holds the value. It does
not accept an autofill: it has `autocomplete="off"`, thus a browser and a password manager do
not write in it. The user types the date in the segments.

props.name: children
props.description: Makes one segment for each part. It receives the data of the segment. The default is a plain segment.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the input with segments.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Replaces the invalid state that assistive technology reads. The component sets it while the text does not make a valid value.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the date picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while a segment inside the input has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the text in the segments does not make a valid value.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the calendar popover is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the date picker is readonly.

parts.name: Segment
parts.description: One segment of the date: the day, the month, the year, or a separator. The user can type in it, and the arrow keys change its value.

props.name: segment
props.description: The data of the segment, from the children snippet of the Input.

dataAttributes.name: data-date-picker-segment
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a date picker segment element.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the segment has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while the segment shows its placeholder and not a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The segment type, for example 'day', 'month', 'year', or 'literal'.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: The button that opens and closes the calendar popover. In the read-only mode, it is not in the DOM.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button, for example a calendar icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the trigger has focus.

parts.name: Popover
parts.description: The panel that floats and contains the calendar. It accepts Popover.Content props, for example placement, offset, and shouldFlip. The component controls the open state, the reference to the trigger, and the id. The default placement is bottom-start, and the focus goes first to the active day cell.

props.name: offset
props.description: The distance from the anchor element, on the main axis.

props.name: placement
props.description: The position against the anchor element.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Moves the panel to the opposite side when the space is not sufficient.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: The element that gives the limits of the position.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the popover.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the popover container.

props.name: nonModal
props.description:
Makes the popover non-modal. The user can then operate the page, the focus does not stay in
the panel, and the page scrolls.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Closes the popover when the user clicks outside it.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Closes the popover when the user pushes the `Escape` key.

props.name: shouldCloseOnBlur
props.description: Closes the popover when the focus goes out of it. The default is true for a non-modal popover.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: The element, or the selector of the element, that gets the focus first in the modal mode.

props.name: open
props.description: The open state, when you use the part alone.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: The reference to the trigger element, when you use the part alone.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The component calls it when the open state changes, when you use the part alone.

parts.name: Calendar
parts.description: The calendar in the popover. It accepts Calendar.Root props. It does not accept the props that DatePicker.Root controls, for example selectionMode, value, disabled, readonly, and isDateUnavailable.

props.name: children
props.description: The calendar parts: the triggers, the heading, and the grid.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: The selection behavior: 'single' selects one YYYY-MM-DD date, and 'range' selects a { start, end } pair.

props.name: visibleMonths
props.description: The number of the months that the calendar shows together. It also sets how far the triggers move.

props.name: showOutsideDays
props.description: Shows the days that are not in the current month.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: Replaces the first day of the week of the active locale.

props.name: monthHeadingStyle
props.description: The format of the heading: 'composed' uses one string from the locale, and 'month-year' makes a month part and a year part.

props.name: minValue
props.description:
The first date that the user can select (`YYYY-MM-DD`). A date before it is unavailable, and
the triggers and the focus stop at this limit.

props.name: maxValue
props.description:
The last date that the user can select (`YYYY-MM-DD`). A date after it is unavailable, and the
triggers and the focus stop at this limit.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Makes specified days unavailable. The user cannot select them. Those cells keep the focus, and they have aria-disabled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the full calendar, with the triggers and the day selection.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the keyboard operation of the calendar, but stops the changes of the selection.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the root element. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the calendar, for when the user sees no name.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected date in the single mode, or the range in the range mode. You can bind it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The date or the range at the start, for when the component controls the state.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it with the new date or the new range, after the user selects.

parts.name: TriggerPrevious
parts.description: The button that moves the calendar to the previous month.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button, for example an icon or a name.

parts.name: Heading
parts.description: Shows the heading of the month, in the language of the active locale.

parts.name: TriggerNext
parts.description: The button that moves the calendar to the next month.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the button, for example an icon or a name.

parts.name: Grid
parts.description: Makes the month into an accessible grid. The month heading gives the grid its name.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the grid, usually GridHeader and GridBody.

props.name: weekdayStyle
props.description: The length of the weekday names in the header: 'narrow', 'short', or 'long'.

dataAttributes.name: data-calendar-grid
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the grid element.

dataAttributes.name: data-calendar-month
dataAttributes.description: The ISO month (YYYY-MM) rendered by this grid.

parts.name: GridHeader
parts.description: The header row of the weekdays. It goes through the localized weekday names and gives each one to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description:
Your own content for a header cell. It receives the weekday name in the length of
`weekdayStyle`, and also the long weekday name. Use the long name as the accessible name when
the short one is narrow. In some locales, "M" is the narrow name of Monday and of Wednesday.

parts.name: HeaderCell
parts.description: One cell with a weekday name, in the header row of the grid.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the weekday name.

parts.name: GridBody
parts.description: The area of the day cells. It goes through the days that the user sees and gives each ISO date to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: Makes one body cell for each day. It receives the ISO YYYY-MM-DD date.

dataAttributes.name: data-week
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a week row inside the grid body.

parts.name: BodyCell
parts.description: One day cell that can take the focus. When the user selects it, the picker takes the date. By default, the popover then closes.

props.name: date
props.description: The ISO YYYY-MM-DD date of this cell, from the snippet of GridBody.

props.name: children
props.description: Your own content for the cell. It receives the day number. The default is the day number.

dataAttributes.name: data-date
dataAttributes.description: The ISO YYYY-MM-DD date of the cell.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the user cannot select the day, because it is disabled, out of the range, or unavailable.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the cell.

dataAttributes.name: data-in-range
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day falls inside a selected range (range calendars).

dataAttributes.name: data-outside-month
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day is in the month before or the month after.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell is actively pressed.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-end
dataAttributes.description: Present on the last day of a selected range (range calendars).

dataAttributes.name: data-range-start
dataAttributes.description: Present on the first day of a selected range (range calendars).

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day is the committed value.

dataAttributes.name: data-today
dataAttributes.description: Present on today's date.

dataAttributes.name: data-unavailable
dataAttributes.description: Present when `isDateUnavailable` makes the day unavailable.
